front: (HL) Area of a triangle with vectors?
(HL) Area of a parallelogram with sides $\mathbf v$, $\mathbf w$?

front: (HL) $\mathbf i\times\mathbf j$, $\mathbf j\times\mathbf k$, $\mathbf k\times\mathbf i$?
back: $\mathbf k$, $\mathbf i$, $\mathbf j$ (cyclic order); reversing the order gives the negative.
Perpendicular to both, given by the right-hand rule (first finger $\mathbf v$, second $\mathbf w$, thumb $\mathbf v\times\mathbf w$).

front: (HL) Why not find the angle between vectors from $|\mathbf v\times\mathbf w| = |\mathbf v||\mathbf w|\sin\theta$?
back: $\sin\theta$ cannot distinguish $\theta$ from $180^\circ - \theta$; use the scalar product for angles.

front: (HL) Main use of the vector product in geometry?
back: Finding a vector perpendicular to two given directions — e.g. a plane's normal, or the direction of the line where two planes meet.
